Network reconstruction from dynamics and behavior

dynamics_block_state.Rd

Native C++ implementations of indirect network reconstruction from dynamical time series and equilibrium behavioral snapshots (Peixoto 2019, 2024, 2025), supporting all 10 graph-tool dynamical/behavioral models, L1 (Laplace), Gaussian, and quantized MDL weight/node priors, joint flat/nested SBM community detection, and declarative L1 regularization path sweeps.

Usage

pseudo_ising_block_state(s, graph = NULL, has_zero = FALSE,
  x = 1, x_range = c(-Inf, Inf), theta = 0, theta_range = c(-Inf, Inf),
  xdelta = 1e-8, tdelta = 1e-8, disable_xdist = FALSE, disable_tdist = FALSE,
  xl1 = 1, tl1 = 1, sbm = NULL, nested = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = FALSE, q_max = Inf)

ising_glauber_block_state(s, graph = NULL, directed = TRUE, has_zero = FALSE,
  x = 1, x_range = c(-Inf, Inf), theta = 0, theta_range = c(-Inf, Inf),
  xdelta = 1e-8, tdelta = 1e-8, disable_xdist = FALSE, disable_tdist = FALSE,
  xl1 = 1, tl1 = 1, sbm = NULL, nested = TRUE, blocks = NULL,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  self_loops = FALSE, q_max = Inf)

  xl1 = NULL, tl1 = NULL, normal = FALSE, mu = 0, sigma = 1,

dynamics_transmission_probs(state)

Arguments

s

An \(N \times M\) numeric/integer matrix of node observations (or a list of \(N \times M_c\) matrices representing independent time-series cascades or restarts). See Details for per-model value and preprocessing requirements.

graph

Optional initial rgraphtool_graph with \(N\) vertices. If NULL, reconstruction starts from an empty graph.

directed

Whether the reconstructed graph is directed.

has_zero

For Ising models, allow three-state spins -1, 0, 1 instead of binary -1, 1.

exposed

For epidemic models, use SEI/SEIR transitions where newly infected nodes transition from 0 (susceptible) to -1 (exposed) before becoming 1 (infectious).

fix_mean

For Gaussian models, center each vertex's observations to zero mean across samples.

positive, pslack

For pseudo_normal_block_state(), enforce strict diagonal dominance (positive definiteness) of the reconstructed precision matrix with margin pslack.

f, q

For Potts models, the \(q \times q\) spin interaction matrix (defaulting to the \(q \times q\) identity) and number of discrete spin states \(q \ge 2\).

x, x_range

Initial edge weight(s) (scalar, edge property name, or vector) and allowed weight interval c(xmin, xmax).

theta, theta_range

Initial node parameters (scalar, length-q_t vector, or \(N \times q_t\) matrix) and allowed bounds.

xdelta, tdelta

Quantization precision parameters \(\Delta\) for edge weights and node parameters.

disable_xdist, disable_tdist

If TRUE, disable quantized MDL weight/node distributions and use continuous L1 (Laplace) regularization instead.

xl1, tl1

L1 / Laplace scale parameter(s) \(\lambda\) for edge weights and node parameters.

sbm

Include the flat or nested SBM structural prior (TRUE) or reconstruct without community structure (FALSE).

nested, blocks, degree_corrected, degree_prior, self_loops, q_max

SBM prior configuration options.

state

A rgraphtool_dynamics_block_state (or rgraphtool_dynamics_reconstruction for precision/transmission helpers).

latent_edges, density, aE, xdist, tdist, xdist_uniform, tdist_uniform, normal, mu, sigma

Prior and description-length component overrides matching graph-tool's DynamicsBlockStateBase.entropy().

breakdown

If TRUE, return a named list separating total, nll, geom_prior, x_prior, t_prior, and sbm.

niter

Number of greedy MAP coordinate-descent / candidate-edge sweeps.

nsamples, burnin, thin, beta

Optional posterior MCMC sampling controls (set nsamples > 0 and finite beta = 1 to collect posterior marginal edge probabilities and weight/parameter uncertainties).

k_cand

Number of correlation-screened candidate partners per vertex for subquadratic scaling on larger networks.

w_step, t_step

Random-walk proposal half-widths for finite-temperature edge weight and node parameter MCMC updates.

tol

Stopping tolerance in nats for greedy MAP optimization.

refresh_every

Active-set candidate refresh period (in greedy MAP iterations) using residual correlations, 2-hop neighbors, and SBM block proposals; set 0L to keep initial candidates fixed.

merge_split

If TRUE and sbm = TRUE, perform multilevel merge-split sweeps inside DynBlockPrior during greedy MAP optimization.

threshold

Marginal edge-probability threshold for the returned graph.

xl1_values

Grid of L1 regularization strengths \(\lambda\) swept with warm starts in reconstruct_l1_path().

truth

Optional ground-truth rgraphtool_graph or 2-column edgelist matrix used to compute precision, recall, F1, and ROC-AUC along the L1 path.

Details

Input and preprocessing conventions by model family:

  • Ising (pseudo_ising_block_state, ising_glauber_block_state): integer spins in {-1, +1} (or {-1, 0, +1} with has_zero = TRUE); continuous Ising models accept real values in [-1, 1].

  • Epidemics (epidemics_block_state): integer states with 0 = susceptible, 1 = infectious (and -1 = exposed when exposed = TRUE; recovered states such as 2 are handled automatically). Edge weights \(x_{ji} \le 0\) encode transmission probabilities \(t_{ji} = 1 - e^{x_{ji}}\) and node parameters \(\theta_i \le 0\) encode spontaneous infection probabilities \(r_i = e^{\theta_i}\).

  • Continuous Gaussian (pseudo_normal_block_state, normal_glauber_block_state, linear_normal_block_state): real observations. For empirical financial or sensor time series, convert levels to stationary log-returns or first differences and standardize each variable to zero mean and unit variance before fitting.

  • Potts (pseudo_potts_block_state, potts_glauber_block_state): integer categories in 0..(q - 1).

Value

Constructors return a rgraphtool_dynamics_block_state. dynamics_description_length() returns a scalar DL (or component breakdown list). reconstruct_dynamics() returns a rgraphtool_dynamics_reconstruction containing the inferred edges data.frame, reconstructed graph, estimated theta and theta_sd, updated state, and entropy trace. reconstruct_l1_path() returns a rgraphtool_l1_path with ranked summary, per-lambda fits, and BIC-selected best_fit. dynamics_precision_matrix() returns the precision matrix, partial correlation matrix, sigma, and mu. dynamics_transmission_probs() returns edge transmission probabilities and per-node spontaneous infection probabilities.

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2019). Network reconstruction and community detection from dynamics. Physical Review Letters 123, 128301. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.123.128301

Peixoto, T. P. (2025). Network reconstruction via the minimum description length principle. Physical Review X 15, 011065. doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.15.011065

See also

simulate_ising, simulate_epidemics, simulate_normal_dynamics, simulate_potts, evaluate_edge_prediction, demo("dynamics_reconstruction"), demo("empirical_dynamics")

Examples

set.seed(1)
g <- graph_create(8, directed = FALSE)
graph_add_edges(g, rbind(cbind(1:7, 2:8), c(8L, 1L)))
s <- simulate_ising(g, weights = 0.6, n_samples = 200L, burnin = 100L, thin = 2L)
st <- pseudo_ising_block_state(s, nested = FALSE, xdelta = 1e-4, tdelta = 1e-4)
rec <- reconstruct_dynamics(st, niter = 10L, xdist = FALSE, tdist = FALSE, sbm = TRUE)
rec
#> <rgraphtool_dynamics_reconstruction (pseudo_ising)>
#>   Inferred edges: 8 | Final DL: 867.7359 (NLL: 683.7808)
#>   Moves: 69 / 268 | Prior: sbm=TRUE, xdist=FALSE, xl1=1
